niche.habitat: Deep rift vent fields (1.8x Earth heat flow, pH 4–6.5 gradients)
niche.diet: Chemosynthetic symbionts, suspended metal-sulfide particles, vent fluids
niche.active: Continuous; slow growth and sintering cycles

body: Columnar, branching silicate-sulfide composite plates; heat-shock protein-lined sintering chambers; basaltic dorsal heat-sink; vent-facing intake fronds

links: Bakes suspended sulfides into dense composite armor
Vent fluids precipitate metals when cooled by body heat
High geothermal heat flow accelerates crystallization (Note: native metal reduction remains fantasy; biology concentrates/precipitates only)

skill.effect: The creature vents a protective heat wave that coats the ground, wrapping nearby allies in a shimmering barrier that strongly deflects incoming strikes.

observe: Water shimmers with heat haze around base
Silt cakes in precise geometric rings

journal.en: It doesn't grow. It cements the vent itself.

plausibility.summary: Rewrite the chambers as mixing/templating surfaces where vent fluid meets cool seawater, with heat-shock proteins shielding the lining; the armor is precipitated sulfide/oxide, never native metal. Keep 'it cements the vent itself' and delete all stat numbers.

links: Maintains internal reactor temperatures for symbionts

skill.effect: The creature radiates a warm, inviting scent that draws nearby chemolithotrophs into a gathering pool, where they linger and yield their bounty more readily.

chains.weakness: Overheats and loses symbionts if displaced to shallow water
observe: Dorsal plates glow dull red under vent light
Symbiotic bacteria bloom in thick clouds around intake
Vent currents bend smoothly around its spine

journal.en: It wears the vent's fever as a second skin.

fixes: Make the plates passive thermal dampers that keep symbionts inside their tolerance; any red is reflected light, not incandescence; change the weakness to loss of vent chemistry and gradient, not overheating in shallow water.

links: Free metals denature proteins above 1 µM concentration

skill.effect: The creature gathers metal crystals within its nodules, holding them ready for use. These stored metals can be collected to craft items or brew alchemical concoctions.

chains.weakness: Cannot relocate when heavily laden with nodules
observe: Internal nodules click softly when brushed
Water clears immediately around its base
Gills filter metallic particulates into glowing sacs

journal.en: It swallows the mountain's blood and spits out crystal.

temperament: Sedentary, defensive, slow-reacting, highly territorial over vents
secrets: Sintered plates can be harvested for high-grade sulfide ore.
Releases a cloud of heat-resistant spores when fractured.
Symbiotic bacteria inside produce heat-stable enzymes used in crafting.
moments: Watching it slowly extrude a glassy, sulfide-rich plate over a vent mouth, the heat warping the water above it like a mirage.

journal.en: It doesn't eat. It bakes the water into armor.
The vents sing through its crystalline ribs.
